capabilities: keep the active line at a fixed vertical position with typewriter mode
dim text outside the current line, sentence, paragraph, or section
scroll to the top or bottom of a note via commands
auto-scroll daily notes to the bottom on open
hide scrollbars and map mouse-wheel movement to cursor lines
extras: Most features are disabled by default and must be enabled in the plugin's settings panel.
motivation: The author built it to fix practical issues they had while writing in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks typewriter-style line centering, focus dimming, and quick jump-to-top/bottom scrolling for long writing sessions.
summary: Writing-aid plugin that adds typewriter mode, a focus mode that dims surrounding text, and commands for quick scrolling within notes.
